name: New Zealand Landsat II Investigation Programme, 1975–1977
story: DSIR’s Physics and Engineering Laboratory coordinated a national Landsat II investigation with surveying, geological, forestry, agricultural and university contributors. The September 1977 report names authors and institutional affiliations and records the image-processing and applied mapping work.
